title: Dave Altman connects the transient dates to the Washington flap

tellings.quote: And then my colleague, Dave Altman, who is the manager media manager for WASCO, he said, "Do you know what happens on or what happened on 19th of July, 1952?"

plain: Some of the strange flashes of light that appear on old sky photographs and then vanish may line up with July 19, 1952, the night a wave of UFO sightings over Washington, D.C. began. The astronomer Beatriz Villarroel tells Michels that her colleague Dave Altman, media manager for her research group, asked her, "Do you know what happens on or what happened on 19th of July, 1952?" If the dates truly match, the flashes in the sky photographs and the sightings over the capital could be linked.
